name: Is a kitchen refresh worth it on a foreclosed property, or should I leave it as-is?
description: Yes, if the kitchen is structurally sound, a refresh often boosts appeal and photos without overspending. Focus on visible improvements buyers notice right away

mainEntity.name: Is a kitchen refresh worth it on a foreclosed property, or should I leave it as-is?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-done refresh usually improves first impressions, listing photos, and buyer confidence without the cost of a full remodel. The best outcomes come from focusing on clean surfaces, working cabinets, fresh paint, and fixing anything that would turn off a buyer immediately.
